question: What auspicious subject does the speaker now wish to hear about in relation to time?
premises: The speaker expresses a wish at the present time.
The object of that wish is to hear something.
That something is described as the auspicious deception of time.
inference: The speaker now wishes to hear about the auspicious deception of time.
uncertainties: It is not clear from this verse alone how the deception of time can be described as auspicious.
plain_english: Now I wish to hear the auspicious deception of time.
